english.title: Permit entry onto part of Manchester Airport licensed for surface movement of aircraft
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), other than in an emergency, caused or permitted

(A)_[a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),]_
(B)_[vehicles]_
(C)_[aircraft servicing equipment, namely **(..SPECIFY EQUIPMENT..),]_

to enter part of Manchester Airport, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PART OF MANCHESTER AIRPORT..),
